# NeoNeX MindX

> NeoNeX MindX is a premier data, AI, and analytics educational institute based in Bengaluru, India, providing live online mentor-led career programs, hands-on enterprise capstone projects, LMS access, and transparent career placement support.

## Career Programs

- [Data Analytics Career Program](https://neonexmindx.com/courses/data-analytics-course): End-to-end curriculum covering Advanced Excel, SQL database queries, Power BI interactive dashboards, Python analytics, ETL, and portfolio-ready business intelligence projects.
- [Data Science Career Program](https://neonexmindx.com/courses/data-science-course): Predictive modeling, statistical inference, feature engineering, machine learning pipelines, deep learning foundations, and production deployment.
- [AI & ML Engineering Program](https://neonexmindx.com/courses/ai-ml-engineering-course): Modern machine learning architectures, neural networks, Natural Language Processing (NLP), Computer Vision, Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and scalable model serving.
- [Data Engineering Career Program](https://neonexmindx.com/courses/data-engineering-course): Distributed computing, Apache Spark, Kafka real-time streaming, cloud data warehousing (Snowflake/BigQuery), orchestrators (Airflow), and production ETL/ELT pipelines.
- [Business Analytics Career Program](https://neonexmindx.com/courses/business-analytics-course): Business domain problem framing, KPI metric trees, SQL reporting, Power BI storytelling, exploratory analysis, and executive dashboard design.
- [Generative AI Engineering Course](https://neonexmindx.com/courses/generative-ai-engineering-course): Specialized generative AI curriculum focused on RAG architectures, prompt engineering, agentic workflows, fine-tuning, and LLM application productionization.

## Focused Short Courses

- [SQL Mastery Course](https://neonexmindx.com/courses/sql-course): Relational database architecture, complex multi-table joins, subqueries, Common Table Expressions (CTEs), window functions, indexing, and query performance optimization.
- [Python Programming for Data & AI](https://neonexmindx.com/courses/python-programming-course): Clean Python programming fundamentals, object-oriented concepts, data structures, automation scripts, Pandas, NumPy, and data manipulation.
- [Excel, Power BI & Tableau Specialization](https://neonexmindx.com/courses/excel-power-bi-tableau-course): Business dashboard engineering, DAX calculations, Power Query automation, Tableau visual analytics, and decision reporting.
- [Machine Learning Foundations](https://neonexmindx.com/courses/machine-learning-course): Supervised and unsupervised machine learning algorithms, cross-validation, hyperparameter tuning, scikit-learn, and model interpretability.

- [Contact & Counselling](https://neonexmindx.com/contact-us): Connect with our course counselling team, schedule an orientation session, or visit our Bengaluru campus.
